page.description: Place the following blocks on this page of the base config (positional, authoritative)

extern.description: Reference an existing object owned by Loxone Config

block.description: Managed logic block (compiler-owned), no arguments yet

block with arguments.description: Managed logic block with label, input wire, and parameter

program.description: PicoC program block; the program text comes from a file next to this .lxir file (D40)

template.description: Reusable body, expanded per instance with locked identities (D23)

instance.description: Instantiate a template; body blocks get slugs prefixed with the instance name

wire.description: Wire a source output onto an extern port (wires into managed blocks go in their argument list)

wire with expression.description: Expression on a wire; each operator becomes a managed gate block with a deterministic slug (D24)

set.description: Write a parameter (Def=) on an extern port; the original is restored when the line is removed

attribute.description: Assign an extern's title, room or category (D39); a room/category change carries along the children that shared it

unit value.description: Unit-suffixed value in a binding (30min, 250ms, 2700K, 70%) — compiled to the port's base unit (D27)

let.description: Named constant, referenced by bare identifier in value positions

removed.description: Authorize deleting a managed block that was dropped from source

moved.description: Rename a managed block's slug while keeping its identity (UUIDs survive)
